home.sub: What the app is doing right now.
tw.title: Twitch – channel points
tw.sub: The app watches up to two channels at a time in the background (that is all Twitch counts) and claims bonuses on its own.
ch.title: Channels
ch.addPh: Add a channel – name or link
set.pointsHint: Off = the list stays, but nothing is watched for points.
chat.hint: Presence in the chats of all enabled channels.
set.rotateHint: How often (minutes) to switch the watched channels. 0 = always the first live ones on the list.
ch.empty: Add the channels you want to collect points on.
kick.title: Kick – channel points
kick.sub: Channel points on Kick: 10 points for every 5 minutes watched. There are no bonuses to click there, so the app simply "watches".
kick.connectSub: A separate window with kick.com will open. Sign in there as usual – the app picks up the session and closes the window.
kick.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the Kick window. It will close by itself.
kick.manual: Another way: paste the key manually
kick.manualHow: On kick.com press F12 → Network tab → reload the page → click any request to kick.com/api → copy the value of the authorization header (the part after the word Bearer). This key gives access to your account – never send it to anyone.
kick.addPh: Add a Kick channel – name or link
kick.maxHint: The first live ones on the list are watched.
kick.empty: Add the Kick channels you want to collect points on.
kick.noWindow: Could not open the sign-in window (no Edge/Chrome?). Use the manual way below.
kick.closed: The window was closed before Kick handed over the session.
kick.badKey: Kick did not accept this key – connect the account again.
kick.blockedHint: Kick's protection did not let the app through (403). Retrying every few minutes.
kick.waitHint: If the sign-in form does not appear, click "Log in" in the top right corner of the page.
camps.sub: Click games in the order they should be farmed. Right click = track the game ★. The ⓘ icon shows exactly what can be earned.
camps.err: Could not load campaigns – retrying shortly.
queue.sub: Games are farmed one after another. Each one shows its campaigns and every reward.
track.title: Tracked ★
track.hint: start by themselves when a campaign appears
set.dropsHint: Watches streams of the queued games, one by one.
set.autoClaimHint: Only when the game account is linked to Twitch.
set.stall: Switch stream when a drop is stuck for
q.linkTip: Link the game account to Twitch
q.empty: The queue is empty – pick games in the Drop campaigns tab.
track.empty: Right-click a game in the Drop campaigns tab to track it.
fact.any: any channel of this game with drops enabled
camp.noTimed: This campaign has no rewards for watch time.
farm.waitRead: Waiting for the first progress reading from Twitch…
chn.liveWait: live · {game} · waiting for a free slot
slot.waitRead: watching, waiting for a progress reading
slot.waitLive: waiting for someone on the list to go live
det.none: There is no campaign for this game right now.
log.sub: Everything the app has done since it started. The full record is in the file data\log.txt.
set.autostartHint: Starts quietly, straight into the tray next to the clock.
set.openHint: Off = after starting, only the tray icon is visible.
set.about: Closing this window stops nothing. Open the panel with the tray icon.
upd.autoHint: A new version downloads itself from GitHub and replaces the app file.
upd.failed: Could not check for updates – will try again later.
upd.never: Updates have not been checked yet.
gate.title: Sign in to Twitch
gate.sub: A separate window with Twitch will open. Sign in there as usual – the app picks up the session and closes the window.
gate.alt: Window not working? Sign in through your own browser
gate.altSub: Twitch will open in your everyday browser and you will paste here the address it redirects to.
gate.autoTitle: Sign in in the Twitch window
gate.autoWait: Waiting for you to sign in. The window will close by itself, nothing needs to be copied.
gate.pasteTitle: Paste the address from the browser
gate.step1: Twitch has opened in your browser (sign in if it asks).
gate.step2: When the home page has loaded, click the address bar and copy the whole address Ctrl+L Ctrl+C. It starts with twitch.tv/#access_token=
gate.keyWarn: This address is the key to your session – never send it to anyone. It stays on this computer only.
gate.net: No connection to Twitch – retrying shortly.
note.expired: Twitch did not accept this session – sign in again.
note.wrongclient: That was a different session. Sign in again with the button below.
note.closed: The sign-in window was closed before Twitch handed over the session.
toast.dup: This channel is already on the list.
toast.badName: That does not look like a channel name.
toast.badKickKey: That does not look like a Kick session key.
toast.noToken: There is no session key in this address – copy the whole address from the Twitch page.
L.wrongClient: This is not a session from this app's sign-in – sign in again with the button in the panel.
L.expired: Twitch did not accept the session (expired, or the address was incomplete) – sign in again.
L.loginManual: Sign-in: opening Twitch in the everyday browser.
L.loginWinFail: The sign-in window did not start (%v) – switching to the everyday browser.
L.loginGot: Sign-in: Twitch handed over the session, closing the window.
L.chatDenied: Chat: Twitch rejected the chat sign-in – chat presence is off.
L.camps: Drop campaigns: %d (in progress on the account: %d).
L.claimFail: Could not claim the drop: %s (%s) – claim it in your Twitch inventory. [%s]
L.streamEnded: %s: the stream of %s ended – looking for the next one.
L.solo: %s: progress is stuck – pausing the second channel while this drop is farmed.
L.noStreams: %s: no streams with drops – checking again in 5 min.
L.kickBlocked: Kick refused the connection (403, %s) – its protection did not let the app through. Retrying every few minutes.
L.kickBadKey: Kick did not accept the session key – connect the account again.
L.kickWinFail: Kick: the sign-in window did not start (%v).
L.kickGot: Kick: session received, closing the window.
